issues: Covers rose and sales beat target, driven by large office groups and walk ins, while spend per head fell because of loyalty app ramen deals and half price offers.
Deliveroo late prep orders increased because a new back of house hire was slow on gyoza and mixed up chicken and vegetable gyoza orders; that hire is being let go after the training period.
A missing Fanta on a delivery order was identified through the photo proof on the dedicated iPad, and photo checks are now mandatory.
Labour rose because of training the new back of house hire and adding one extra person at lunch.
The wet variance ran adverse, attributed to soft drink training.
The Google rating improved after a one star review was removed.
A new front of house starter worked shifts before their right to work check had cleared, which is not permitted.
No compliance tasks were late but they were not ticked off in the compliance app, so four daily alarms have been set.
Weekly GM and head chef meetings have not been happening, causing gaps between front and back of house on events such as Freshers.
A manager is strong on floor service but needs support with rotas and KPI sheets, with video training ongoing.
Customers ordering pork ramen and then saying they cannot eat pork is causing waste and remakes.
Two new front of house team members have joined, and two back of house trial shifts were not passed.
Service and quality issues noted: a missed dessert ticket, bins without liners, not every chef greeting guests, salty broth and cold chicken karaage.
Cleanliness is an area for improvement, and a kitchen cooker deep clean was scheduled for 20/09.
Only one chef was available on the hot section for the Sunday sushi roll offer (12:00 to 14:00), which needs extra cover.
Upcoming: a Freshers event and possible Hilton events.
